_doc: Definition Google Sheets the Drive->GitHub sync (tools/sync-drive.mjs) reads server-side to rebuild data/courses.json. Each sheet's rows become a course's screens; the File column holds a content/<code>/... path or a URL. Edit the '(live)' sheet, then the next sync run (every 5 min, or the manual button) updates the live course.

sheets.title: Introduction to Microcontrollers
sheets.description: The full Flowcode + E-blocks 3 introduction to microcontroller programming. 12 bronze/silver/gold worksheets plus sensor, motor, and assessment screens spanning analogue I/O, interrupts, displays, and web mirror projects.

sheets.title: Digital Techniques for Aviation Technicians
sheets.description: EASA Unit 5 Digital Techniques for Aviation Technicians, delivered as a SCORM-ready browser course. Microcontroller fundamentals through to motor control — adapted for aviation maintenance learners.

sheets.title: Microcontrollers for T-Levels
sheets.description: T-Level Engineering microcontroller pathway built on the CP4807 / CP1972 / CP0507 worksheet base. Covers digital and analogue I/O, motor control (including stepper), interrupts, and full assessment-led progression.
